messages:
sara.chen: FYI customer hit a hard 400 on /v1/rerank when sending a bulk job via our JS SDK v2.3.1. They say payload looked 'normal' but server rejected it.

sara.chen: here's the raw payload they sent (minified):
```json
{
  \"items\":{\"req_1\":{\"id\":\"req_1\",\"query\":\"find similar docs\",\"candidates\":{}},\"req_2\":{\"id\":\"req_2\",\"query\":\"compare answers\",\"candidates\":{}}},
  \"top_k\":\"5\"
}
```

sara.chen: response from API: 400 with body:
```json
{
  \"error\":\"invalid_request\",
  \"message\":\"items must be an array of request objects\",
  \"details\":[\"candidates for req_1 must be an array\",\"top_k must be integer\"]
}
```

devon_h: can you paste the curl they used and Content-Type?

sara.chen: they called via our sdk helper; when i asked for curl they sent a quick repro:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundary' \
  --data-binary $'------WebKitFormBoundary\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"payload\"\r\n\r\n{"items":{"req_1":{...}},"top_k":"5"}\r\n------WebKitFormBoundary--'
```

devon_h: ah ok — looks like the SDK is sending the JSON inside a form field which changed arrays/empty arrays into objects in some bundlers. top_k also got stringified.

alexg: this matches a known issue with SDK v2.3.1 where we accidentally call `Object.fromEntries` on arrays while normalizing before FormData. Issue #412 tracks it. Workaround is to send raw JSON with `Content-Type: application/json` or coerce fields to proper types before sending.

support-bot: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-412|INFR-412> noted — SDK team assigned.

marco_r: short-term patch: ask customer to POST raw JSON (no form-data) or ensure `items` is an actual JS array and `top_k` is a Number. Example payload that worked for them: 
```json
{
  "items": [
    {"id": "req_1", "query": "find similar docs", "candidates": []},
    {"id": "req_2", "query": "compare answers",  "candidates": []}
  ],
  "top_k": 5
}
```

sara.chen: patched and repro'd with customer. After switching to raw JSON and numeric top_k they got 200 and expected rankings. Customer accepted workaround and requested ETA on SDK fix.

alexg: marking as regression, will include fix in next SDK patch (v2.3.2).

sara.chen: leaving this thread for triage, will follow up with customer once SDK patch is out :thumbsup:

marco_r: noted, closing customer loop tomorrow. :tada:
